name: grid-select
summary: The grid / table dropdown (obs-grid-select) — a dropdown whose menu is a searchable TABLE, not an option list: columns · per-row checkboxes · sortable header · a search box · a selected-count badge + View Selected / Clear Selected. Rich cells via a column `type` (text · status · severity · type-icons). The product's 'Select Agent / Select Monitor' picker (FlotoDropdownGridSelector + MonitorPicker/AgentPicker, ~70×). The open table floors at 720px wide so the View Selected / Clear Selected actions sit on one line and more columns are visible.

variants.name: single
variants.what: pick one row → closes + reflects el.value = row id

variants.name: multiple
variants.what: checkboxes + Select-All + selected badge + View/Clear Selected; el.value = JSON id array

columns.note: [{key,title,width?,align?,sortable?,type?}] — JSON string or a JS array property. Passed straight to the inner obs-table, so ALL its cell `type`s work: text (default) · severity (obs-severity dot + name; level from the row's sev/severity field) · dot (obs-severity dot + level label) · status (obs-tag) · type (product type icons) · tags · sparkline · heat · bar.

rows.note: [{id, …}] — JSON string or a JS array property; each row keyed by `row-key`.

value.note: selected id (single) or JSON id array (multiple); reflects to el.value on every edit.

multiple.note: checkbox multi-select + Select-All + badge + View/Clear Selected

events: change — { detail: id (single) | id[] (multiple) } (array-wrapped, unwrap detail[0])
decisionFlow: Picking a rich RECORD that needs multiple columns to identify (name · IP · type · status), often multi-select? -> Grid Select.
Picking a simple {label} value from a list? -> the Dropdown picker / Select, not this.
A menu of ACTIONS (Edit/Delete)? -> a Menu, not this.
do: Use for agent / monitor / device / interface / user / profile selection — records needing columns to tell apart.
Give a column a `type` (any obs-table cell type — severity/dot/status/type/tags/sparkline/heat/bar) for the DS severity dot (obs-severity), status tag (obs-tag), product type icons, etc.
Use multiple for bulk selection (checkboxes + Select-All + the selected badge + View/Clear Selected).
dont: Don't use for a short fixed {label} option list (use the plain Dropdown/Select).
Don't use for a menu of commands/actions (use a Menu).

grid-select.useWhen: the user picks a rich RECORD identified by multiple columns (name/IP/type/status), often multi-select with checkboxes — the menu is a searchable table, not a plain list.
grid-select.dontUse: for simple {label} options (Dropdown/Select) or a menu of actions (Menu).
grid-select.example: Select Agent / Select Monitor pickers (~70×): agent, monitor, device, interface, RUM service, integration/SNMP-trap profile, user selection.

a11y.summary: The trigger is a button with the selection/placeholder. The open menu is a table; give sortable headers aria-sort, selectable rows aria-selected, the header checkbox = select-all, arrow-key row nav, and announce the result/selected count. The menu renders in the top layer (Popover API).

knownIssues: [element] obs-grid-select is FUNCTIONAL: pass columns + rows (JSON/array), single or multiple; it reflects el.value (single id / JSON id array) and emits change on every edit. Menu renders in the top layer (Popover API) so it's correct inside animated ancestors. Column `type` drives severity/status/type cells.

[element] The dropdown grid IS the DS <obs-table> (composed): grid-select owns the trigger + search + selected-actions and drives obs-table's selection via :selected + @change/@rowclick. It does NOT re-implement the table — sorting, checkboxes (obs-checkbox + select-all/indeterminate), status tags (obs-tag), sort icons (obs-icon long-arrows), and cell types all come from obs-table.
changelog: 2026-08-06 — Hardening: stop the internal native <input> `input` event from leaking out of the shadow DOM (@input.stop) so a stray composed native `input` (e.detail=0) can no longer reach consumer listeners on the host. Same class of fix as obs-input.

2026-07-22 — Width (owner): the open dropdown TABLE now floors at 720px (was 520) so the header actions — search + count + View Selected | Clear Selected — fit on one line with spare room, and more of the table columns are visible; still grows to a wider trigger.

2026-07-13: full docs treatment (owner) — added the prose spec (specs/grid-select.md) with the variants-and-when-to-use table, anatomy, props/events, a11y; rounded out the Elements gallery (single/multiple/no-search/block/disabled/rich-cells); refreshed the columns note (every obs-table cell type works) now that the grid IS obs-table. Severity cells render obs-severity (dot), status cells obs-tag.

2026-07-13: refactored to COMPOSE <obs-table> (owner) — grid-select was hand-rolling its own <table> (built before obs-table existed), which duplicated the grid chrome AND diverged: text-glyph sort arrows (↑/↓), a hand-rolled checkbox span, and a hand-rolled status pill instead of the DS primitives. It now renders <obs-table selectable sortable hide-selection-info> inside the dropdown and owns only the trigger/search/selected-actions, driving selection via :selected + @change/@rowclick. Deleted the duplicated table/checkbox/cell code; the glyph arrows are now obs-icon long-arrows, the checkbox is obs-checkbox, the status is obs-tag — verified render + multi/single selection + sort.

2026-07-11: shipped the real <obs-grid-select> web component (the grid/table dropdown, ~70×). Trigger reflects the selection; searchable table with sortable columns, checkbox multi-select + Select-All + selected badge + View/Clear Selected; rich cells via column type (severity ring / status tag / product type icons); value reflected to el.value + change event. Top-layer popover menu. Fixed a round-trip corruption (JSON id array was re-split as one literal) so selection highlights correctly.

sizes.name: menu
sizes.note: the open dropdown table floors at 720px so the header — search + selected-count + View Selected | Clear Selected — fits on ONE line with room to spare, and more of the columns (MONITOR/IP/TYPE/GROUPS/TAGS) are visible; it still grows to match a wider trigger.
